internalEvidence: Starting instructions were checked on rendered publisher pages, including relevant mode context. Publisher source context: https://www.dvgiochi.com/area-download/. Finding: Whoever most recently visited a city center is the starting player. Local source SHA-256: db9cb85d5cd7d2fede0d12deaa0ef8035d213b488f0b20571a5306ebfed1ab17. The instruction specifies a city center; it does not require a visit to Rome or to an ancient forum. The publisher-hosted PDF has a dV Giochi watermark. Editorial review 2026-09-23: Rechecked the cited starting instruction, role and opening-turn context against the publisher PDF, including rendered image-only pages. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22.
uncertainty: No starting tie-break is stated alongside this instruction.
The answer applies to the identified publisher file; other editions may differ.
